newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon indicts five Red Army suspects.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon indicts five Red Army suspects.

text.p: A Beirut investigative judge on Thursday issued an indictment charging five Japanese Red Army guerrillas with offences carrying up to 10 years in prison, judicial sources said.

In his indictment, issued after nearly one month of interrogations, investigative judge Saeed Mirza said the charges included "passport forgery, illegal entry to Lebanon, and official stamps forgery", the sources said.
A Lebanese woman arrested in connection with the case would be tried for illegally practising medicine. She was found innocent of charges of collaboration in forgery offences, the sources said.

Kazua Tohira, Haruo Wako, Mariko Yamamoto, Masao Adachi and Kozo Okamoto were arrested on February 15 and Lebanon announced that it would try them in Lebanon despite Japanese hope of extraditing them to face international charges arising from guerrilla activity.
